week.label: Tue 11-17 1pm → Tue 11-24 1pm
week.rule: Build up to 85% until Sunday's fantasy run, then use it up to 95% (Mon–Tue morning). Fantasy: Thu ~7pm and Sun 12:30pm, ~2 each.

cost_note: Estimates come from your measured usage log (Sonnet small fix 0–1, medium 1–3, Opus big build ~3). Each finished step records its real cost, and estimates are adjusted. Step 2 measured ~1 weekly vs est. 4–6: step sizes can be trimmed. Each step now logs clock start/end (started, ended, minutes) so time estimates can be added later.

steps.name: Log it right
steps.why: Stops the app from saving things wrong without telling you, before you log more coins.

items.what: Each album uses its own want list
items.change: Your Morgan album only says "wanted" for coins on its own list, and filling a spot (any way, Fill spots too) crosses it off that album's list, not another one.
Where from and Paid with from your last coin show as "Same as last: Coin show ✕" so you can see and clear them in one tap, instead of filling in silently.
Pressing Back fast no longer wipes your metal prices; Back on a half-filled coin asks "Discard this coin?"
items.affects: Metal prices, Add coin, New album, Fill spots

items.change: You tick only the coins you have; "Tick all" is still one tap for a full album; Save says "Add 54 coins?" first. Proof spots no longer block Save.

try: Open two albums of the same type: each spot says "wanted" only for its own album's list.
Add a coin, then start another: Where from shows "Same as last: … ✕" instead of being silently filled in.
Type a metal price and press Back fast: the price is still there. Start a coin, press Back: it asks "Discard this coin?"
Open Fill spots: nothing is ticked; tick 2, Save asks "Add 2 coins?"

steps.name: Grab it, log it, go
steps.why: Makes logging fast, and gives you one easy way to fix your 200+ coins that need info.

items.change: One button jumps to the next coin missing cost, where from, grade or mint; fill it in, Save, and it goes to the next one.
Coins where the mint wasn't chosen land in Needs info so the fix-up run catches them. No new saved field.
The Needs info filter no longer sticks after you leave My Coins, and foreign coins follow the same rules as US coins.
If you opened Price or Photos on the last coin, they're open on the next one: about half the taps when logging a stack.
"1921 morgan", "1950 D", "silver" and "grandpa" find coins, not just exact phrases.

items.what: No double coins from Fill spots
items.change: If you already own that date loose, Fill spots offers to put that coin in the spot instead of making a second one.

try: Tap the fix-up button: it opens the first coin missing info; Save jumps to the next one.
Search "1921 morgan" and "silver": coins show up.
Add a coin with Price open, then add another: Price is still open.
Fill spots on a date you already own loose: it offers to use that coin.

steps.name: Know a key date: mintage list
steps.why: Mintages from U.S. Mint records, so key dates show on spots and coin pages even without a price file. Part 1 (v0.79.0) and part 2 (v0.80.0, 11-18) done: cents, nickels, dimes, quarters, halves, dollars, Seated series, 1964-65 by date. Spot-checked 11-18 against his Red Book: all 10 match once proofs (and the 1873-CC No Arrows line) are added.

items.what: Mintage list from U.S. Mint records: part 1 done (v0.79.0)
items.change: Mintages show on album spots and coin pages even without a price file. Each says "from U.S. Mint records". Free, public-domain source only. You spot-check ~10 key dates against your Red Book first.

Added Barber, Walking Liberty and Franklin halves (commemoratives taken out), 1964 and 1965 coins by the date on them, Seated Liberty dimes, quarters, halves, half dimes and dollars, 3-cent silver and 20-cent pieces. Fixed 1900 Morgan and 1893 quarter (commemoratives were counted). Still left out: 1909 cents, 1916 dimes and quarters, 1938 and 1942 nickels, 1921 Philadelphia dollars, Capped Bust and older, minor coins before 1871, proofs, 1966 on.

try: Open an empty spot for a 1921-S Walking Liberty half and a 1938-D Walking Liberty half: mintage shows, "from U.S. Mint records".
Open a 1964 Washington quarter (no mint mark): it says "coins dated 1964" and includes San Francisco coins.
Check ~10 key dates against your Red Book (mix of halves, cents, Morgans, Seated) and send any that differ in one message.

steps.name: Know a key date: coin card
steps.why: Look up any coin, owned or not, like at the pawn shop: mintage, melt and eBay sold in one place.

items.what: Card for a coin you don't own
items.change: Tap an empty spot or a search result and see a coin card: mintage, key-date flag, melt today (from your silver price), a "Search eBay sold" button, and "Add to want list".

items.what: More facts on the coin card (added 11-18)
items.change: The card also shows: metal and silver content (e.g. 90% silver, 0.36 oz); known varieties for that date to look for; your price-list value when one is loaded (shows the list's own name, e.g. Red Book or Greysheet; hidden when no list is loaded); and "You own 2" / "Empty spot in your album" so you don't buy a duplicate. Uses facts the app already has; nothing new is saved.

try: Tap an empty album spot: a coin card shows mintage, melt today and "Search eBay sold".
Search a coin you don't own: the same card opens.

steps.name: Fresh-start repo
steps.why: Already planned (N4/G): a clean copy of the project for testers. You do a few GitHub taps.

items.change: Nothing changes in the app; it's a tidy home for the tester version.

try: Nothing to tap in the app; follow the GitHub steps the chat gives you.

steps.name: Card for any coin you search
steps.why: The part of 3b that was left out: look up a coin you don't own and that isn't in an album, like at the pawn shop.

items.change: Search for a coin and tap a result to see the same coin card as an empty spot: key date, mintage, melt today, varieties, and how many you own. Also checks that the "Search eBay sold" and "Add to want list" buttons promised in 3b exist; adds them if not.

try: Home: type 1916 dime in the new Search any coin box; you land on Coins with the rows.
Key date shows first with a small ⓘ; tap it to see how it's decided.
Tap a row for the card, then Add to want list.

steps.name: Private tester copy (plan, then build)
steps.why: Only the testers you invite can open the app, and your code stops being public, so nobody passes it around before you sell it.

items.change: Questions for that chat: tester emails, the tester-copy name, and whether your own app stays on its current address (recommended for now, because your coins live on your phone at that address).

Tester copy on Cloudflare Pages (free) behind Cloudflare Access (free up to 50 users): testers sign in with an email code; you can remove anyone. Shows "Tester copy for [name]". Code made private only once your own app no longer depends on the public GitHub site (making it private now would take your phone app offline).
items.affects: Where testers open the app; your own app is not moved without a backup and your OK

try: Open the tester link in a private window: it asks for an email code.
Try an email that isn't on the list: it is refused.

steps.name: Mint "Can't tell" + Skip in Fix-up (plan)
steps.why: Plan how to tell "no mint mark", "P" and "can't tell" apart, and add a Skip in Fix-up tick, without breaking your 500+ saved coins.

items.what: Plan only: mint "Can't tell" + smart default
items.change: The mint dropdown gets No mint mark, P and Can't tell. "Not chosen yet" is the only to-do state. Years where only Philadelphia struck that coin fill in themselves. Opus maps everything that reads the mint, runs the 4-box check as a plan, and writes the Sonnet build list.
items.affects: Saved coins (mint), Fix-up, mintage, albums, filters, reports, CSV, backup

items.change: A tick on a coin stops it from nagging you. It leaves a small skipped mark, and totals stay estimates. Planned together with the mint change because they touch the same screens.
items.affects: Saved coins (new flag), Needs info, Fix-up

items.what: Make the "coins need info" line easy to see
items.change: The Home line "404 coins need info, totals may be off ›" looks like plain text and is easy to miss. It becomes a gold-outlined button (maybe a "Fix them" chip) and jumps straight into the Fix-up run. Opus decides the spot and fits it into the schedule.
items.affects: Home totals shelf, Needs info, Fix-up

try: Nothing to tap yet: this step is a plan. The build comes after.

steps.name: Album accuracy
steps.why: Album spots always match real coins.

items.change: A coin put in the 1909 VDB or 1878 7 Tail Feathers spot is saved as that variety.
The 1895 Morgan spot says "Proof only" and warns on a circulated grade.
"+ Add a spot" refuses dates or mints the series never had.
Change a coin's variety and it moves to the matching spot (or asks).
"This spot holds your 1879 VF-30. Hide it anyway?" and "4 coins will lose their spot" when you shorten an album's years.

try: Open ?demo, Albums, a Morgan album: tap the 1895 spot. It says Proof only; try adding a circulated coin there and it asks for a proof grade.
Tap + Add a spot, enter 1922 (or 1880 with mint D): it says the series never had it.
Tap a filled spot, Edit spots, Hide spot: it asks first.
Edit album, shorten the years: a note says how many coins lose their spot; tap Save again to go ahead.

steps.name: Album tidy
steps.why: Fewer leftovers and dead ends around albums.

items.what: Delete album asks about its list
items.change: "Also delete its want list (52)?"
Album says "Needs silver price" instead of $0.00.
"Take out of album" right on a filled spot's menu (1 tap instead of 5).
Coins leave their box slot when put in an album, and stop saying "Holder: Album" after leaving one.

items.what: Want-list button does what it says
items.change: "Add to want list" on an empty spot adds to this album's list in one tap.

items.what: Show how many spots are hidden
items.change: Under the album totals: "3 spots hidden · Show". Tap it to open Edit spots, where you can bring them back. Added 11-18 by him.

try: Tap a filled album spot: 'Take out of album' is there (then Undo).
Tap an empty spot: 'Add to want list' adds it right away to the album's own list.
Open an album with hidden spots: '3 spots hidden · Show' under the totals.
Delete a test album that has want-list coins: it asks about them.

steps.name: Quick-add pocket change
steps.actual: ~? (started at 11/46; his end reading goes here)
steps.why: Fill an album fast with everyday coins without grading each one. Added 11-18 by him (idea 118: quick-add for pocket-change coins); goes before step 7 because he is waiting on it to enter coins.

items.change: Everyday coins in normal spots can be added as "Circulated (not graded)", valued at face, with no new grade and no new saved field (it reuses the "Can't grade this one" flag). Allowed by type, not metal: clad dimes, quarters and halves, Jefferson nickels 1946+, Lincoln cents 1959+. Silver, 40% silver, key dates, variety spots, proofs and mint sets still ask for a grade.

Source list gets "Coin roll hunting". Price paid fills with face value for Coin roll hunting, Pocket change and Bank roll (you paid face); only Gift stays $0; every other source (eBay, Coin Shop...) stays blank for you to enter. This changes idea 94 (Pocket change used to fill $0); it only sets defaults for new coins. Any source in the list can be picked, and quick-add remembers your last source until you change it, also for a whole batch.

Kennedy halves 1970-D, 1987-P, 1987-D and 2002-2020 show an NIFC tag (not intended for circulation) next to any grade on the coin card, album spot and coin page. Worked out when read, nothing saved. 2021 and later circulate, so no tag.
items.affects: Coin card, album spot, coin page

items.change: The CSV file keeps Not graded / Circulated coins (no more custom Other grade on import). Filter has a Not graded choice. Demo has 3 sample pocket-change coins.

try: Fill spots on a Washington or Kennedy album: tick a few clad coins, add them as Circulated.
Check a 1965–70 Kennedy half is still treated as silver (melt).
Switch a batch from Pocket change to Coin roll hunting; Price paid becomes face.
Open a proof spot: it still asks for a grade.
steps.note: First check (read-only): if "Circulated" would change how coins are saved (new saved value or conversion), stop and ask him; then Opus plans it with the 4-box check.

steps.name: Upgrades and wanted
steps.why: Upgrading a coin works end to end.

items.change: Spots say "wanted" or "upgrade wanted" so you can tell them apart.
The coin's "Upgrade wanted" tick and the spot's upgrade want are the same thing everywhere.
"Want an upgrade" works for XF-45, AU-58 and the other 7 grades that miss it now.
When the better coin arrives: "Put the MS-65 in the 1881-S spot? Old one goes loose / box / sell."
Changing an album's years and back keeps its variety spots.

try: Tap an album spot you own: 'Want an upgrade' works for any grade (try XF-45).
Spots say 'wanted' or 'upgrade wanted'.
Add a better coin for an upgrade spot: it offers to swap it in.
Change an album's years and back: variety spots are still there.

steps.name: Inherited and names
steps.why: Inherited coins never get mixed up with your own or sold by mistake.

items.change: Inherited albums look different on My Albums and in want-list names.
Inherited albums are never auto-joined to a series with yours.
Two albums with the same number get "(2)" or ask for a name.
Making a box a for-sale case, or editing a sold coin to Inherited, asks first.

steps.name: Easy to read
steps.why: Older eyes and iPhone testers can read everything.

items.change: Options > Look: Normal / Large / Extra large. Works on iPhone too (iPhone ignores the phone's own setting in this app).
At large text, names wrap instead of being cut; album grades are easier to read.
items.affects: Home, Coin Value, album page, Options

steps.name: Easy to tap
steps.why: Fewer missed taps and slips.

items.change: Help ⓘ, section headers, back links, menu rows and Close get comfortable 44 px tap areas.
eBay link moves to the coin page; the star in rows gets a gap so opening a coin doesn't star it.

steps.name: Slips and Undo
steps.why: Mistakes are easy to take back.

items.change: Refund, Take off sale, Move back get Undo; "Return unsold" asks first.
Messages ~6 seconds, Undo ~15 seconds.
"See a full sample" asks before replacing practice coins.

steps.name: First day
steps.why: A new tester's first 10 minutes make sense.

items.change: New users start on Collector; Simple really hides selling buttons.
Welcome card offers "I have a backup file"; New box explains what's wrong.
Fixes "Placed in .", "Delete ?", wrong help text; says "No price list loaded" instead of sounding like a checked answer; removes the "coming soon" photo line.

steps.name: Numbers agree
steps.why: Every screen shows the same totals.

items.change: Album value, Home and reports all treat Business coins the same way.
Home shows one "how many coins"; value labels make sense.
Refunded coins return to the For sale list; Business-only Home shows your stock.

steps.name: Seller accuracy
steps.why: Testers who sell see correct numbers (new seller features wait for 2027).

items.change: Refund fees, deleted shows and tags add up the same in every report.
Impossible years can be fixed; an unknown album number asks instead of guessing.
Restore says it replaces albums, boxes and shows.

steps.name: Options regrouped
steps.why: Less to wade through (your "it's a lot").

items.change: Options in a few clear sections, most-used first. No search box.

steps.name: Fix check before testers
steps.why: A simulated tester re-runs every finding we fixed and confirms each is really gone and nothing else broke, before real testers see the app.

items.change: No app change. A report lists each fix as confirmed, half-done or broken; anything not confirmed goes back in the queue before testers.

try: Read the short report; nothing to tap.

steps.name: Fill-ins (leftover usage)
steps.why: Small extras to use up the end of the week.

items.change: Hide values also hides melt on every page.
Filter coins by where they came from (e.g. Inherited).
Offers "Put a coin I have here", not only a new coin.
Filtered lists can include coins you're missing.
Move a coin straight from one album's spot to another's.
Pocket albums show value and grades.
Undo on Fill spots gives the coin ID numbers back.
Selling the same coin in two tabs warns instead of replacing.

items.t: Home shelf "looks like a mess" (idea 110): which screen? Also bookcase names written sideways (R6-10)
